name: Badge
intent: Small, static status or label descriptor.
when: Status pills, counts, tags on cards/rows

chooseOver.because: Chip is interactive (filter/attachment); Badge is a static label

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Badge for an interactive filter
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Use for an interactive filter — use Chip

docs.summary: A small, static status or label descriptor. Use for labeling status, category, or count next to content.
usage: Use Badge to display static status indicators, counts, or category labels on cards, table rows, or navigation items.
Choose a variant by meaning (success for positive states, destructive for errors) rather than by color preference. Badge is non-interactive; for clickable or removable pills, use Chip instead.

parts.name: Container
parts.description: The badge wrapper with rounded corners, border, and background color based on variant.

parts.name: Leading icon
parts.description: Optional icon placed before the label text. Should be small (size-3) and reinforce the status meaning.

parts.name: Label text
parts.description: The text content of the badge. Keep it short — one or two words maximum.

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing or loading.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style variant. Choose by meaning: success for positive, destructive for errors, soft variants for subtle indicators.

props.name: children
props.description: Badge content — typically short text, optionally with a leading icon.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the badge container.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML div attributes are supported.
